verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a patent and trade mark office offering online search (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister) and e-filing services could plausibly publish official SDKs or programmatic APIs. The evidence shows only web portals, paper or fax filing, and the downloadable DPMAdirektPro desktop application for preparing filings, which is not a developer SDK. Nothing in the pack documents an official SDK or client library to build against.
